title: PEX14 acts as a molecular link between optineurin and the autophagic machinery to induce pexophagy.
authors: Li, Hongli; Chen, Suyuan; Lismont, Celien; Vandewinkel, Bram; Hussein, Mohamed A F; Costa, Claudio F; Imberechts, Dorien; Liu, Yiyang; Azevedo, Jorge E; Vandenberghe, Wim; Verhelst, Steven; Waterham, Hans R; Vanden Berghe, Pieter; Baes, Myriam; Fransen, Marc
one_liner_zh: 该文研究PEX14与OPTN在过氧化物酶体自噬中的分子连接机制，属细胞生物学湿实验，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Pexophagy, the selective degradation of peroxisomes, is essential for removing excess or dysfunctional peroxisomes, and its dysregulation has been linked to various diseases. Although optineurin (OPTN), an autophagy receptor involved in mitophagy, aggrephagy, and xenophagy, has also been implicated in pexophagy in HEK-293 cells, the underlying mechanisms remain unclear. Using proximity labeling, we identified PEX14, a peroxisomal membrane protein, as a neighboring partner of OPTN. Microscopy analyses revealed that clustering of peroxisomes with OPTN is a key feature of OPTN-mediated pexophagy. Biochemical studies demonstrated that PEX14 and OPTN interact through their coiled-coil and ubiquitin-binding domains, respectively. Further analyses showed that the C-terminal half of overexpressed OPTN triggers pexophagy, likely by oligomerizing with endogenous OPTN. The colocalization of PEX14-OPTN complexes with LC3, together with the suppression of OPTN-mediated peroxisome degradation by bafilomycin A1, supports a model in which PEX14 acts as a docking site for OPTN on the peroxisomal membrane, enabling the recruitment of the autophagic machinery for OPTN-mediated pexophagy.
abstract_zh: 过氧化物酶体自噬（pexophagy），即过氧化物酶体的选择性降解，对于清除多余或功能异常的过氧化物酶体至关重要，其失调与多种疾病相关。尽管 optineurin（OPTN）作为一种参与线粒体自噬（mitophagy）、聚集体自噬（aggrephagy）和异源自噬（xenophagy）的自噬受体，也被认为在HEK-293细胞中介导过氧化物酶体自噬，但其潜在机制尚不清楚。通过邻近标记技术，我们鉴定出过氧化物酶体膜蛋白PEX14为OPTN的邻近相互作用伙伴。显微镜分析揭示，过氧化物酶体与OPTN的聚集是OPTN介导的过氧化物酶体自噬的关键特征。生化研究表明，PEX14与OPTN分别通过其卷曲螺旋结构域和泛素结合结构域相互作用。进一步分析显示，过表达OPTN的C端半部分可能通过与内源性OPTN寡聚化来触发过氧化物酶体自噬。PEX14-OPTN复合物与LC3的共定位，以及巴弗洛霉素A1抑制OPTN介导的过氧化物酶体降解，支持一个模型：PEX14作为OPTN在过氧化物酶体膜上的对接位点，从而招募自噬机制以实现OPTN介导的过氧化物酶体自噬。
